brief:
Green Party leader Zack Polanski is mounting a challenge to Labour in Holborn and St Pancras, the London constituency Keir Starmer held before becoming party leader, Al Jazeera English reported. Labour has controlled the seat since its creation in 1983. The race appears to centre on divisions over Palestine, with pro-Palestine candidates targeting the traditionally safe Labour constituency.

The contest reflects broader tensions within Labour over Gaza, which have intensified since Starmer took the helm. Holborn encompasses parts of central London and has consistently returned Labour MPs by substantial margins in recent elections.
dek: Green Party leader Zack Polanski hopes to shake Labour, which has held Holborn since the seat was created in 1983.
title: Greens challenge Labour in Starmer's former Holborn seat
